original_benchmark.notes: Native XPolicyLab embodied policies; no standard Harbor CLI compatibility is claimed. RoboDojo revision f57e1633ffed59761bc8e568cfe7530c4b33381c. There are 42 canonical tasks and 54 runtime configurations including randomized variants.
Excluded: physical hardware, scene resets, and the remote real-world evaluation service are not packaged.

harbor_adapter.notes: Draft Direct-mode integration: a vision model sends bounded end-effector targets through a custom Harbor agent, and the unchanged native evaluation scores the episodes. Validated only by CPU tests with a fake simulator and a fake model. GPU execution, a passing oracle, parity experiments, and registry publication are pending. No score matching is established. None parity-agent entries mean no experiments, not evidence of matching.
